title: The last night
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The night before the bus. Chloe comes to the bedroom window. The dog lets her in.

panels.composition: Wood's bedroom, night. A knock at the window. BARNABY's head up. WOOD at the table.

image.prompt: a young man at a bedroom drawing table at night turning toward a knock at the window, a small dog lifting its head, black and white

panels.composition: The window up. CHLOE climbing in, the way she must have at fifteen. Barnaby greeting her like she's his.

balloons.text: Your mother's asleep. I'm not knocking on a door at midnight.

image.prompt: a young woman climbing through a bedroom window at night while a small dog greets her joyfully and a young man watches from his table

panels.composition: The two of them on the floor, backs to the bed. The dog between. Nobody talking. The corkboard above: the map he drew her, pinned — no, she has that. The bus schedule. The letter.

characters.pose: on the floor, back to the bed

image.prompt: a young woman and a young man sitting on a bedroom floor with their backs against the bed and a small dog between them, a crowded corkboard above, night, no words

panels.composition: Chloe's hand on the dog. Wood's hand on the dog. Not touching. The whole arc in a dog.

image.prompt: close-up of two hands resting on a small dog's back, not touching each other, black and white
image.notes: 'Don't come.' 'I won't.' — He does; the Greyhound cover has him outside the window.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: He says he won't come. The oversized cover shows him there.
